# LUXÉA Los Angeles

> LUXÉA is a curated luxury visitors guide to Los Angeles, published by Ignyte Transformational Media, a women-owned independent luxury media and publishing house founded by Brigitte Perreault. The first edition prints in Spring 2027 in a 4 × 9 inch pocket format, with a print run of 30,000 copies placed by hand in luxury hotels, private clubs, restaurants, cultural institutions and curated locations across Greater Los Angeles, the South Bay, Malibu and Palm Springs. A second edition follows in Spring 2028.

The guide is organised in seven curated sections: Stay, Dine, Shop, Wellness, Culture, Night and Escapes. It is curated rather than comprehensive — inclusion is editorial. A companion directory at luxeala.com runs year round.

## Key facts

- Publication: LUXÉA — A Collector's Visitors Guide to Los Angeles
- Publisher: Ignyte Transformational Media (women-owned)
- Founder and Publisher: Brigitte Perreault
- First edition: Spring 2027. Second edition: Spring 2028
- Format: 4 × 9 inch pocket guide, with a detachable map and a gold QR code
- Print run: 30,000 copies
- Distribution: Greater Los Angeles, Orange County to Santa Barbara, and Palm Springs, in partnership with Certified Travel Media
- Readership: 55% women, ages 35 to 60, average household income above $300,000
- Giving: 1% to the planet, and 1% to planting trees in California through Evertreen
- Contact: brigitte@luxeala.com · partners@luxeala.com · +1 213 444 3364

## About the founder

Brigitte Perreault is the founder and publisher of LUXÉA Los Angeles. She previously founded Ignyte Magazine, a digital title that reached 300,000 subscribers across 62 countries in three years, and was a founding partner of The Maven Co., now The Arena Group, publisher of Sports Illustrated and TheStreet. She also founded Green Glamour World, a sustainable luxury platform, and is the author of *Why Is The Sky Blue?*. She is based in Los Angeles.
